summary: Practise prospecting, BANT qualification, SPIN discovery and follow-up. Explore the five-day professional selling skills course.
lede: Selling professionally means researching prospects, discovering customer needs and qualifying suitable opportunities, practical work for sales representatives and other customer-facing specialists. This foundation course builds skills in call planning, BANT qualification, SPIN discovery questions, relevant value messages, objection responses and clear CRM follow-up to help learners agree next steps and record decisions.
audienceIntro: This foundation course is designed for people who engage prospects or customers, qualify sales opportunities, present offers, and maintain customer follow-up.
prerequisites: Foundation level; no prior professional sales training is assumed. Bring a current or realistic customer-selling scenario for practice.
